title: Retired Waves
description:
Retired Waves is a narrative video game by Bing Liu. It lasts about 30 minutes and has no traditional mechanics, goals, or objectives. Instead, it tells the story of a being wandering through their thoughts and reflecting on the meaning of architecture.



All soundtracks are produced by Michael Hoiming Du.



It has been a year since I released this game. I have not done any advertising or shared any stories or thoughts behind the scenes. If you like this game and wish to know more about it, please leave a comment below.
